method: Assistant visual inspection of three actual downloaded publisher-linked images through view_image; not an automated vision-model API experiment.

records.title: Pride Party
records.monetaryMeaning: Donation for discounted-drink wristband; not established as admission price.
observedErrors: Original full-image OCR did not yield a date/time phrase.
Manual schedule crop produced incorrect 16-10 PM.
Donation amount was not recovered by the tested OCR/extractor variants.

records.title: Florida Forever Festival
observedErrors: Year is absent on the flyer; recover it only from separate publisher evidence.

records.title: Karaoke Night
records.monetaryMeaning: Flyer says free; publisher event description corroborates it, without establishing all entry conditions.
observedErrors: Original/contrast OCR found karaoke and free but the extractor did not recover 9PM.
Threshold variant lost the free signal.
The image has a 2023 Last-Modified header while its event page presents a 2026 occurrence; image age does not date the event.

limitations: Three selected images, not a representative benchmark.
No invented years or entry prices.
No complete transcripts, photographs or contact information retained in Git.
